purpose: Teach: 一豊/姫路/遡る/騒がせ/無口/高台/打線/東京ドーム

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、一豊、絶対、公の、絶対、医療史への関心、絶対、医療界、絶対、興味深いですよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, your interest in medical history is genuinely fascinating. I appreciate it deeply.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Steady eye contact. Clear articulation on the compliment. Unhurried pace—there's genuine respect here, not performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 姫路、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、医療体制、絶対、貴院、絶対、関わって、絶対、いらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: You mentioned that your hospital is involved with the regional healthcare system here in Himeji. Is that right?
lines.style: Respectfully curious, leaning forward slightly. Genuine question—not testing, but genuinely wanting to understand. Soft uplift at the end.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの症状を、本気for、絶対、遡る、絶対、と、絶対、原因、絶対、見えてきます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When you trace back a patient's symptoms carefully, the underlying cause becomes clear.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, pedagogical but not condescending. The voice of someone used to explaining. Slight emphasis on 'trace back' — the key idea. Steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: マスコミを、本気で、絶対、騒がせ、絶対、た、絶対、医療事故、絶対、医療界、絶対、対応、絶対、大変でしたよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I imagine dealing with a medical incident that got media attention must have been quite difficult for your team.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Acknowledging gravity without drama. Slight pause before 'quite difficult'—genuine recognition of the weight. Warm undercurrent.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さん、本気で、絶対、無口、絶対、な方、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、お話、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We listen carefully to our patients, especially those who are quieter. The medical team takes real time with them.
lines.style: Steady, almost gentle. Pride in the approach without self-congratulation. Slight slow-down on 'listen carefully.' Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、高台、絶対、診療所、絶対、貴院、絶対、運営、絶対、されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've heard that you also run a clinic up in the hills in the local area. Is that something you're involved with?
lines.style: Curious, respectful inquiry. Leaning in slightly—this is a genuine question about something that matters. Open, not probing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。プロ野球選手の、本気で、絶対、打線、絶対、入りの方、絶対、当院、絶対、ご利用、絶対、ですよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We actually treat some professional baseball players—people from the batting order who come through our facility.
lines.style: Light touch of pride. Almost matter-of-fact delivery, as if this is simply part of what they do. Clear, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 東京ドーム、本気で、絶対、での、絶対、救急対応、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、ご経験ですか?先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Have you had experience with emergency response at Tokyo Dome? Does your team handle that kind of work?
lines.style: Respectful, almost tentative. The question matters—there's genuine curiosity. Slight rise at the end. Not pushing, but genuinely wanting to know.
